description: Tests (1) goal completion recognition: weight goal set at target 185 lbs, user reports progressive weight loss across multiple turns, ultimately hitting 183 lbs — system should mark goal as achieved/completed; (2) lab value trend: cholesterol was reported as 224 in an earlier turn, then 187 in a later turn — most recent (187) should be present in recall; (3) exercise goal mid-trace update (partial → full compliance). Failure modes: goal not marked complete when target is reached; old lab values overwrite or coexist ambiguously with new ones; partial progress notes lost.
